While the static checks evaluated 'passes_minimum' as true (likely because the 5th-percentile thickness is 2.053mm), the presence of sub-1mm regions violates the strict 2.0mm uniform thickness requirement for FDM printing. Lastly, the AI agent formatted its output with markdown backticks, causing a parsing anomaly, but the data was still fully interpretable and aligned with static bounding box measurements.
